**Scope:** Directly derive and implement sharp **mathematical** rate-box projections under GL2022 JCP157 214302 Eqs. (5)–(7). No native reactive state-rate input or scientific DAG-node admission.

- Frozen R17A parent PR153 HEAD `d08683a50a57c7bebc8a871e0021c2f8b5520fa9`. Add-only isolated child branch. No main merge or existing science mutation.
- Derived exact `K(T)=Σ_(j,r) [(2j+1)e^(-ΔE_j/kBT)/Z] s_r k_jr(T)`, `s_r=1/4` even and `3/4` odd. **Weight sum = 5, not 1**. Native SQM H+ + HD -> D+ + H2 reactive only.
- Proved conditional sharp `0<=k_a<=K/w_a`, exact finite box interval projection, and conditional exact rational Boltzmann-factor-interval weight bounds. No real HD E_j, rate table, source rounding or physical interval certified. Selected `HD(v0,j2)->H2(v'0,j'1)` remains input-missing.
- Implemented [theory and proofs](research/wu_hd_thermal_projection_r17b_20261029/THEORY_KO.md), [Fraction-based module](research/wu_hd_thermal_projection_r17b_20261029/src/thermal_projection.py), [6 pytest](research/wu_hd_thermal_projection_r17b_20261029/tests/test_thermal_projection.py), [independent-algorithm LP 120 cases](research/wu_hd_thermal_projection_r17b_20261029/tests/independent_lp_probe.py), and synthetic-only [plot renderer](research/wu_hd_thermal_projection_r17b_20261029/figures/render_sensitivity.py).
- Actual verification: pytest **6/6**, Wolfram exact **12/12**, SciPy HiGHS **120/120**, max abs difference **4.440892098500626e-16** at a fixed **1e-9** check. Four Python source/test/renderer Git blob IDs matched locally executed bytes.
- [R1–R10/C1–C10 scoped stage ledger](research/wu_hd_thermal_projection_r17b_20261029/delivery/STAGE_LEDGER.json): **18/20**, nonauthor R6 PARTIAL, distinct-author C9 NOT_RUN. Native subagents unavailable, NOT_RUN. Parent R17A independently **19/20**, remains separate.
- Original WU science DAG **33/48** unchanged, REI central last observed **28/88** and separate working PR257 **33/88**; no newly adopted physics. `HH_R10=OFF`, `production=NOT_ISSUED`, `L4=false`.
- Local original 12-member source ZIP 119817 bytes, SHA256 `7c7fa69482adf455a929f64ff0a140c5a355bb2c3809c71cd7f8123d66a55627`, CRC/member-sha checked; **new Drive/Dropbox original ZIP upload NOT_DONE**. Git text source and handoff are remote; binary figure and ZIP local. Prior R17A Drive backup remains separate.
- Original publisher GL2022 supplementary raw bytes/SHA and selected state rate/T/method, certified HD energies, source-row distinct-author audit, and actual REC/CR density-clock-full-A consumer remain OPEN. Avoid EMAA/LAMDA nonreactive confusion and TIQM/SQM mixing.

[Copyable handoff](research/wu_hd_thermal_projection_r17b_20261029/delivery/HANDOFF_NEXT_THREAD_KO.md). All prior PRs remain draft/unmerged.
